description: Break down US federal contract spending by agency for a given fiscal year (default: current year) and optional quarter (1-4). Returns agency names, abbreviations, and dollar amounts from USAspending.gov.

fiscal_year.description: Four-digit fiscal year (e.g., "2025"). Defaults to current year.

quarter.description: Fiscal quarter (1-4). Omit for full year.

name: usa_spending_by_agency

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year used for the query

quarter.description: Fiscal quarter if specified, otherwise null

total.description: Total federal spending for the period

title: Usa Spending By Agency
